description: Candidate single-Spark vLLM binding from MiaAI-Lab/Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4-DFlash-DGX-Spark at c9b07101: NVIDIA's exact Qwen3.6 27B NVFP4 checkpoint with the z-lab Qwen3.6-27B-DFlash draft (10 speculative tokens), TP1, bf16 KV cache, flash_attn, 256K context, 4 sequences, Qwen3 reasoning and qwen3_coder tool parsing, and upstream's froggeric v20 chat template with thinking on and preserved. Upstream runs the mutable vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-aarch64 tag; this recipe pins the arm64 image current on 2026-09-29 (vLLM build 36768d1b), so behaviour can differ from upstream's measurement. Upstream claims (not measured here): about 45.6 tok/s single stream and 102 tok/s aggregate at 4 streams. The upstream README's language-model-only line is not in its start.sh and is not applied; vision serving is unproven. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. Memory follows the creator's settings: gpu-memory-utilization 0.84, as in MiaAI-Lab's start.sh at c9b07101 (line 83). The steady per-node peak is 0.84 x 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus 8 GB for CUDA context, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers (a speculative draft is profiled inside the utilization budget); the reserve is 8 GB, and admission keeps the platform memory floor free beside the peak.
title: Qwen3.6 27B NVFP4 DFlash vLLM single Spark (Mia)
